description: A React component implementing a role comparison page. It fetches roles, competencies, performs gap analysis (both via RPC and local logic), and displays competency overlaps, gaps, and related learning resources. It handles user role selection, data fetching, and visualization of the comparison data.

classes.name: React.FC
classes.description: Functional React component type used for the Compare page.

methods.name: difficultyScore
methods.description: Maps textual difficulty levels to numeric scores to assist in ranking learning resources.

methods.name: fmtLevel
methods.description: Formats proficiency levels for display; defaults to 0 if undefined.

methods.name: competencyNameForId
methods.description: Retrieves the competency name corresponding to a competency ID from the list of role competencies.

methods.name: StatusPill
methods.description: React component that visually indicates the gap status for a competency (Good, Minor Gap, Gap).
